en:
## New Features

- Add configurable safety reflection controls while preserving strict safeguards for high-risk commands
- Improve narrator list management with consolidated views, richer archived filtering, and better search metadata
- Add Codex quota forecasting and scheduled usage refreshes to keep account availability accurate
- Improve narrator plan mode, safety handling, rendering, and gateway settings

## Bug Fixes

- Harden danger reflection pause resolution to avoid races and keep normal permission UI focused on actionable requests
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增可配置的安全反思控制项，并继续保留高风险命令的严格保护
- 改进叙述者列表管理，整合视图、增强归档筛选并补充搜索元数据
- 新增 Codex 配额预测和定时用量刷新，帮助准确判断账号可用性
- 改进叙述者计划模式、安全处理、渲染表现和网关设置

## 修复

- 强化危险反思暂停的决议流程，避免竞态并让普通权限界面只显示可操作请求
